author: /root/audit_coordinates
actual_inputs: Original hT/hS/Through03/field/e0 and actual old K, with its retained reference half midpoint cells.

An existing positive cell map with the geometric fact that each true positive midpoint belongs to that cell. The existing exists_wholePositive_midpoint_material_cells or decay provider supplies this fact.
The same arbitrary supplied psi/chi/h0/tau/sigma/Q/N of the actual V record; there are no final geometric or material bound assumptions.
proved: The actual current piece membership implies core membership and a common endpointX(sample V.cell) <= endpointX(point)+A bound, valid before restricting the state.
For every fixed P>=0, uniform pointwise H(point)/H(sample V.cell) and E0(sample V.cell)^P bounds by powers of E0(point).
For every 0<beta<gamma and real coefficient cost P, H(point)^gamma*E0(point)^P <= B*H(sample V.cell)^beta on all current pieces.
same_witness_guards: The positive cell map is never reselected; only its actual midpoint membership is used.
The negative cell is never replaced by C.cell or a whole-component host.
The actual V chart/gauge/height/transport and material data are unchanged.
All constants precede states/pieces/points; no raw optical/Morse or whole-positive common-cell assumption is introduced.
scope_limits: This is not the full CanonicalPrimitiveGeometry.materialJets or ReferenceJets certificate.
The positive point-to-sample reverse E0 bound and both-direction six ratio spatial jet bounds remain separate obligations.
The height residual loses exponent: beta is strictly smaller than gamma, so this alone does not give an exact Hsample^(3/4) CurrentJets bound.
No original E0>=1 or changed material datum is assumed.
